final: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_usage FROM station_averages) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_station_usage, AVG(s.avg_usage - b.avg_usage) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.avg_usage > b.avg_usage
